Step-by-step mode in /studio, or a shots count or scenes array on POST /api/v1/storyboard and /mcp, builds a custom scene list. Scenario mode and input prose are on the same endpoints. A premise shaped as Name, trait, trait keeps those people and the real actions. Prose that cannot be planned returns 400 and lists what is missing. Open /agents for the endpoints. No API key and no account. Mode ad, series, and explainer are light presets on the same endpoints. The video prompt is short by default (prompt_style short or detailed). Each character has one lock line, copied unchanged into every shot they are in. A shot marked promptEdited is kept when the film sheet, prompt style, style preset, or model changes. Regenerate this shot rebuilds one prompt. Risk warnings never block the board. Quick idea, Step-by-step, continuous story, and scenario share one film sheet. format agent resumes any of them. The model can be Grok Imagine, Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway, Luma, Wan, or a generic profile. Shot length and aspect follow that model’s documented limits.
